d08_audit.project_ep_semantics: EP is a subgroup of DP; EP divides DP; EDP=DP/EP
d08_audit.finding: Current Megatron Core documents EP as a separate/foldable parallel dimension. The project EP-as-DP-subgroup profile is therefore not a universal Megatron invariant; a future Megatron adapter requires explicit topology translation.
